assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered.
The study is a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271).
The payer denied the claim under code CO-97.
The documentation fails to demonstrate that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care.
